scripts.build: (cd packages/core && bun run build) && (cd packages/renderers && bun run build) && (cd packages/converters && bun run build)
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:gen && cd docs && bunx vitepress build
scripts.docs:gen: npx typedoc --options typedoc.json --tsconfig tsconfig.typedoc.json --skipErrorChecking packages/core/src/index.ts packages/core/src/debug.ts packages/renderers/src/index.ts --out docs/api/references
